title: On a Mathematical Model Describing Chemotherapeutic Drug Treatment for Tumor Cells
summary: In this paper, we study a semilinear parabolic PDE system which describes the interaction of normal cells, tumor cells, immune cells, with a chemotherapeutic drug. The model extends the previous model with incorporating strong Allee affects in the normal-tissue and tumor dynamics. Under mild assumptions, we establish global-in-time existence and uniqueness of nonnegative weak solutions and derive L-infinity bounds for all time.
